selection.ownership: Hotspot System Ltd, Liszt Ferenc ter 10, Budapest, Hungary (EU Tax ID HU13983981). International Wi-Fi hotspot management API at api.hotspotsystem.com, not a mainland-China edition.

research.searchCoverage: Official HotspotSystem API v2.0 sn-apikey header, GET /me, locations, location options, customers, subscribers, Budapest operator identity, and dated incident search reviewed on 2026-09-13. No qualifying current unresolved HotspotSystem compromise found. Bounded coverage is not a breach-free claim.

Official HotspotSystem API documents HTTPS host https://api.hotspotsystem.com/v2.0 and sn-apikey header. GET /me, GET /locations, GET /locations/options, GET /customers, and GET /subscribers confirmed on 2026-09-13. Operator is Hotspot System Ltd (Budapest, Hungary). Dated incident search found no qualifying current unresolved compromise. Bounded coverage is not a breach-free claim.
research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.
